hardware_observation.initial_screen: appeared stopped at BASIC READY. RUN: for many minutes
hardware_observation.eventual_screen: Lisp65 banner and usable lisp65> prompt
hardware_observation.first_red_rule: stopped on unacceptable boot latency; no downstream hardware case was claimed

root_cause.mechanism: c2_decode_from alternates cursor-sized phase residents. Every c2_overlay_call enters vm_runtime_overlay_exec_family, which wipes, verifies the catalog and record, loads and CRC-checks the payload, executes one tiny cursor unit, and wipes again.
root_cause.why_it_looked_hung: Resolution cursors advance only for matching descriptor kinds while the private local cursor scans every descriptor; screen initialization waits for all decode and publication phases.

rejected_interpretations.basic_deadlock: rejected: C2 cursors advanced and phase 13 completed
rejected_interpretations.irq_or_map_failure: rejected: E000-only MAP kept I/O visible and no IRQ storm remained
rejected_interpretations.decoder_correctness_failure: rejected for this image: finished=1 and error=0
rejected_interpretations.acceptable_product_startup: rejected: approximately twelve minutes is incompatible with an interactive workbench

bounded_next_probe.preferred_direction: Restore one transport per logical decoder phase by using the already proven whole-phase implementations. Move only common product-only helpers into the fixed C2 $e000 facade/resident domain until every phase is again below the 1792-byte slice cap.
bounded_next_probe.preserved_semantics: Each logical phase retains catalog, record and payload verification once; no trusted-stage or validation weakening is permitted.
bounded_next_probe.expected_structural_dividend: Retire cursor-split work state and decoder subphase slices; reduce boot overlay transports from more than 21,000 to approximately one per logical phase.
bounded_next_probe.hard_stop: One bounded facade/whole-phase probe with a real capacity report; any red cap or semantic gate returns for review before Link 25.

claim_limit: Receipt-less hardware diagnosis of Link 24 only. It proves eventual completion for the pinned image and an unacceptable cold-start first-red. It is not hardware acceptance, performance acceptance, product promotion or release evidence.
